parties.claimant: Atul Dhawan Ashok Amir Chand Dhawan

rule_source.instrument: Rules of the DIFC Courts (RDC) Part 38

human_ruling.operative_paragraph: The Claimant's costs referred to in the Order are assessed in the sum of AED 7,127.75.
human_ruling.discrepancy_note: The Schedule of Reasons states 'AED 7121.5 of which AED 1,121.75 is the Court fee. The balance is a claim for 3 hours at AED 2,000 per hour' — i.e. 6,000 + 1,121.75 = 7,121.75. The operative order states 7,127.75. The 6 AED gap is unexplained on the face of the order; we treat 7,121.75 as the predicate-derived value and flag the operative figure as a clerical reconciliation point. (This is itself a useful artifact: the protocol surfaces arithmetic discrepancies the human eye misses.)
